identity.description: An attacker uses PowerShell to download and execute a payload from a known advertising domain, which triggers the 'Rare access to known advertising domains' alert. The behavior is flagged due to uncommon network access patterns to advertising domains by a Windows endpoint.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Unusual PowerShell Network Access
biocs.description: PowerShell process making network connections to advertising domains
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip in ('192.0.2.10', '192.0.2.11')

abiocs.name: Rare PowerShell to Advertising Domain Access
abiocs.description: PowerShell process accessing advertising domains outside of normal behavior
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip in ('192.0.2.10', '192.0.2.11')
| filter agent_hostname not in ('normal-host-01', 'normal-host-02')

xql_queries.name: PowerShell Network Access to Advertising Domains
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip in ('192.0.2.10', '192.0.2.11')
| comp count() as cnt by agent_hostname, action_remote_ip
| comp count() as cnt by
